## About the Template Gallery

The Template Gallery in DingTalk Docs offers 100+ templates across multiple categories, including **meeting collaboration, HR and administration, finance management, proposals, work summaries, and Party building essentials**, covering everyday work needs. Each template seamlessly integrates many of the most practical and highly rated features of DingTalk Docs, making templates **smarter**, dramatically boosting productivity, and helping you stand out at work.

In addition, to better match user habits, DingTalk Docs has added a **My Templates** section. Save your frequently used documents to **Template Gallery — My Templates** based on your individual work scenarios. Next time you edit a similar document, you may only need to change a date or a few data points — efficiency mastery is within reach. 🤩

## How to use

## Desktop

Path: In the left navigation bar of DingTalk, click Docs, then click **Templates** in the upper-right corner to open the Template Gallery.

Select the template you need and click **Use** in the lower-right corner of the template to quickly enter the template editing interface.

## Mobile

Path: **Sign in to DingTalk >> More at the bottom >> Docs >> Template Gallery**

Select and tap the template you need to enter the editing interface.

## Popular template categories

## Work summaries

One of the biggest challenges in the workplace is writing quarterly or annual summaries. Some people produce summaries with sharp focus that stand out and signal strong potential; others write plain, forgettable summaries; and some prefer lengthy essays that nobody wants to read. Try the "Work Summary" templates in DingTalk Docs.

**General and role-based year-end summaries**: Meet the needs of diverse workplace roles. Apply with one click and deliver a clear, well-structured, high-impact year-end summary every time.

## Project management

As the saying goes, getting work done well requires solid project management. Tracking project progress in an orderly way is essential to delivering your responsibilities, and cross-department collaboration also depends on effective project management.

**OKR management:** Give projects both clear goals and tangible results.

**Task progress management:** Track project progress in an organized way and ensure projects are completed on schedule.

## Organization essentials: HR, administration, and finance templates

**New employee onboarding documents:** HR and administration specialists no longer need to spend large amounts of time editing employee onboarding handbooks.

**Company notice templates:** Is there any notice that a notice template can't handle? Just tweak it and send notices out smoothly.

**Common finance management templates:** Financial reports and employee compensation management templates are not only efficient but also visually appealing — no more dull walls of data.
